meta.name: csharp-developer
meta.description: Use when building C# applications with .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core APIs, or Blazor web apps. Builds REST APIs using minimal or controller-based routing, configures database access with Entity Framework Core, implements async patterns and cancellation, structures applications with CQRS via MediatR, and scaffolds Blazor components with state management. Invoke for C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, Entity Framework, EF Core, Minimal API, MAUI, SignalR.

howto.what: 收到 C#/.NET 任务后,Claude 会按 .NET 8+ 规范写代码:异步操作可取消、依赖注入、统一错误处理,配置 EF Core 并检查迁移,用 MediatR 实现 CQRS;产出 API 接口、数据模型、仓储、配置文件等。
howto.when: 当提到 C#、.NET、ASP.NET Core 等词,或要求开发 .NET 8+ 的 API、Blazor 应用、EF Core 时触发。

say.text: 写 Minimal API 接口,支持取消令牌。
say.note: Claude 会生成异步端点并用依赖注入。

say.text: 给订单模块加 EF Core 迁移,先检查迁移文件。
用 CQRS 重构这个 Blazor 组件并加状态管理。
say.note: Claude 会按 MediatR 结构拆分请求和处理程序。

howto.what_en: On C#/.NET tasks, Claude writes .NET 8+ style code: cancellable async, DI, unified error handling, EF Core with migration checks, MediatR CQRS; outputs API endpoints, DTOs, repositories, config files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, or ask to build .NET 8+ APIs, Blazor apps, or EF Core data access.

say_en.text: Write a Minimal API endpoint with cancellation token support.
say_en.note: Claude generates an async endpoint with DI.

say_en.text: Add an EF Core migration for the order module and review it first.
say_en.note: Claude runs ef migrations and checks the generated file.

say_en.text: Refactor this Blazor component with CQRS and state management.
say_en.note: Claude splits requests into MediatR handlers.
